header.description: Larson's Glow Block v1.0.28 - Actual root cause for the 'Unexpected version for the loaded data' spam: resource_pack/blocks.json was using the legacy array-form format_version [1,1,0]; current Mojang samples use the string form "1.21.40". Switched to the string form and the behavior-pack block files now register.
